_comment: Words Kokoro mispronounces → Misaki (US) phonemes; applied as [word](/phonemes/) wherever the word occurs. Changing an entry changes the audio file names (hash of the spoken text). Proposed by tools/tts/check_pron.py --suggest (kept only if ZIPA PER improves) + OOV names from sentence_pron; entries listed in _manual were set by hand and are kept on re-runs.
